units.source_text: 此诗并无深意，薰君听了却不禁流下泪来。

en.t: There was no deep meaning in this poem, yet when Lord Kaoru heard it, he could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 他此时方始自悟：以前对大女公子的恋情其实不浅。

en.t: Only then did he realize for himself that his former love for the elder young lady had in fact been far from shallow.
